values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. Reservations need at least 3 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing' (DEC's 2026 campground summary). A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/fish-creek-pond-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=574 ('Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY; CHECK-IN TIME) + https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf (RES MIN 3 for Fish Creek), read 2026-10-21

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 327 campsites and 3 group camps; equipment lengths 10-40 ft (104 at 40 ft, 125 at 30 ft), and every listed driveway is back-in. Water sites are on the shoreline of Fish Creek Pond or Square Pond.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf ('Fish Creek ... 330' camp sites) + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 574 (all 330 units, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 574 (all 327 campsites 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/fish-creek-pond-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=574 ('restrooms, a shower building, a trailer dumping station'), read 2026-10-21

note: Multiple waterfront campsites, most of which are small and close together  --AWH
summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident and the 3-night pre-season minimum (DEC 2026 summary), ReserveAmerica 9-month window, 14-night max. Added 330 sites to 40 ft (all back-in), no electric, showers and dump. Season left as set 2026-10-20 from RA's 2027 schedule; DEC's 2026 summary gives May 8 - Oct 12. Dropped the --Claude minimum-stay note line (booking.min_stay holds it). dec.ny.gov campground pages answer 403 to plain HTTP; the DEC summary PDF does not.
